shots.prompt:
[shot] medium shot, locked-off static composition, the camera never moves, no zoom, no pan, no parallax
[subject] one strand of hair lifts across the frame and settles back into place, nothing else in the frame moves
[place] the same crossing, the girl closer to camera now, umbrella closed and held down at her side, the crosswalk stripes under her feet
[environment] rain falling as thin straight strokes, constant speed, same direction
[end] by the last frame: the strand of hair has settled, she has not moved her feet, the rain is still falling
[look] 2D cel animation, flat colour fields, hard-edged shadows, constant line width, clean line art, limited palette of deep blue and warm amber, anime background painting, no gradients except the sky band, no texture, no photographic detail, no depth of field, no 3D render
[negative] no camera movement at all, no drift, no reframing, no parallax, no text, no subtitle
